name: Can I use a traditional mortgage to finance a tiny home?
description: No, traditional mortgages typically apply to homes on permanent foundations. Most tiny homes are considered personal property and require alternative financing.

mainEntity.name: Can I use a traditional mortgage to finance a tiny home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Generally, traditional mortgages are not available for tiny homes. Mortgages are typically reserved for real property, meaning a home permanently affixed to land, with a foundation. Most tiny homes, especially those on wheels, are considered personal property. If your tiny home is built on a permanent foundation on land you own, it might qualify for a traditional mortgage, but this is less common and depends on local zoning and lender criteria. You will likely need to explore other loan types.
